system: You are projectbuddy, diagnosing the build machine you run on. Answer the user's question only from the results of the read-only tools you are offered. Call only the tools the question needs, one or two at a time, and stop calling tools once you have the results you need. Each tool result is JSON with a data object; a result with an error or available false means that check could not be made. Values such as <private>, <host>, <ip>, <user> and <path> are redactions: treat them as unknown and never guess what they hide. Never state a value you did not see in a tool result.
answerPrompt: Answer now with JSON only. class: one of the allowed classes, chosen by the rules in the question. finding: one or two plain sentences. citations: 1 to 5 facts you relied on, each with tool (the tool's name), pointer (a JSON pointer into that tool's result as you received it, for example /data/adapters/0/status or /data/drives/0/freePercent) and value (the exact single value at that pointer, copied from the result: a string, number, true, false or null, never a list or an object; to cite a list, cite one item such as /data/adapters/0/gateways/0). Cite only values you saw. If the results do not decide the question, use the class inconclusive and cite what you checked.

questions.text: This machine cannot reach GitHub. Is its own network link the cause? Use network-link. Classes: no-active-link when no adapter has status up; no-default-route when adapters are up but none has a gateway; link-up when an adapter with status up has a gateway; inconclusive when network-link could not be read.

The GitHub Actions runner on this machine shows as offline. Is the runner service the cause? Use services, and event-errors for crashes. Classes: runner-service-missing when no actions.runner service is listed; runner-service-stopped when it is listed but its state is not RUNNING; recent-crash when its state is RUNNING and event-errors lists a critical Kernel-Power or EventLog 6008 event; runner-service-running when its state is RUNNING otherwise; inconclusive when services is not available.

Is the local Ollama server reachable, and is the pinned projectbuddy identity model installed? Use ollama. Classes: ollama-unreachable when reachable is false; no-models when the models list is empty; identity-present when a model has identity true; identity-missing when models are listed but none has identity true; inconclusive when ollama could not be read.

Is VirtualBox installed, and is any VirtualBox VM visible to this account running? Use vm-states. Classes: virtualbox-missing when available is false; no-vms-visible when the vms list is empty; vms-running when a VM has running true; no-vm-running when VMs are listed and none has running true, even if some VMs show an error; inconclusive when the data itself has an error field instead of a vms list.

Is any fixed drive on this machine low on free space? Use disk. Classes: disk-low when any drive has freePercent below 10; disk-ok when every drive has freePercent of 10 or more; inconclusive when disk lists no drives.

Give a short health check of this machine: network link, free disk space, Ollama and runner services. Classes: degraded when no adapter is up, any drive has freePercent below 10, Ollama is not reachable, or a listed service is not RUNNING; healthy when none of those holds; inconclusive when the tools could not be read.
